JD: SINEQUA ENGINEER







Locations: Pan India



Job Description:

We are looking for Enterprise Search Analysts across all levels with strong enterprise search domain experience using the Sinequa Search Platform . You will be responsible for working on complex search features that may include multiple data source integrations. Your role will involve analyzing and indexing data to implement an optimized and readily available search solution. You will also implement various search functionalities to fine-tune and boost search results based on business relevance, facet filters, sorts, and result comparisons, while designing an effective connection strategy from the UI to the Search Platform for a seamless search experience.

In addition, experience or understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), LLM (Large Language Models), ML (Machine Learning), and AI technologies will be considered a strong plus.

Responsibilities:

Creating Sinequa connectors, webapps, nodes, engines, indexers & indexes

Source and collection configuration and indexing for multiple data sources

Metadata mapping and relevance boosting in Sinequa

Creating UI components and retrieving values from Sinequa using REST calls

Creating various Search components like Autocomplete, Filters, and Advanced Search

Monitoring the platform - Task Status, Server Status, Index Status, etc.

Troubleshooting issues using various logs

Deploying and configuring Sinequa using Microsoft Azure DevOps

Qualifications:

Experience in designing, building, and deploying Enterprise Search applications and services, including at least 1-2 years of experience in Sinequa Search

Strong experience in the Enterprise Search Domain and Search Architecture

Expertise in Sinequa Search API , Administration , and Indexing API

Proficiency in core Java / .NET / Angular, Spring, RESTful services

Solid understanding of structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data sources , including SQL and NoSQL databases

Experience in schema design, analyzer, and filter configuration

Exposure to Azure / AWS DevOps / CVS environments

BE/BTech/MS/MCA/MTech (CS/Electronics) or an equivalent degree

Nice to Have:

Experience with other Enterprise Search products (ElasticSearch, Elastic Stack, MindBreeze, LucidWorks, Coveo, Squirro, etc.)

Knowledge of Enterprise Content Management or Knowledge Management architectures (Documentum, Hyland Onbase, Smartlogic, Knowledge Graphs, etc.)

Sinequa Certification

About Left Right Mind:

Left Right Mind was conceived from the realization that humans embody the intersection of logic and intuition. This intersection creates infinite possibilities which can, in turn, create chaos. Our purpose and joy come from distilling clarity from this chaos much like how our left and right brains work together to blend the rational and creative.

Based out of California, Texas, and headquartered in Pune , we are a 100-member team of designers, technologists, strategists, creative thinkers, and problem solvers. At Left Right Mind, we value curiosity, creativity, and collaboration, giving our team the freedom to explore, innovate, and grow
